name: Rifat Sarwar
title: Backend Engineer
voice: I try to take my work seriously, but not myself. Love to code. Fueled by curiosity and occasional panic. Nerd was never an insult.
intro: I build backends that stay up, shrink ML models until they fit on modest hardware, and sometimes write software for machines that drive, grab and fly.
Right now I'm a Senior Software Engineer at Star Technologies, where I own backend architecture end to end. I also work on drone systems, especially the software side.
